ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a 3 V power supply, which reaches a node after passing through a thermistor labeled R_thermistor; this node is connected to ground through R1 on one hand, and on the other hand is directly connected to the non-inverting input terminal + of the operational amplifier. The inverting input terminal - of the operational amplifier is connected to the middle node of the feedback voltage-divider network: R3 feeds back from the output terminal Vout to this node, and R2 is connected from this node to the upper end of a +0.1 V voltage source, whose lower end is grounded. Reasoning: The non-inverting terminal voltage is given by the voltage divider composed of 3 V, R_thermistor, and R1: V+ = 3 R1/(R_thermistor + R1). Under ideal negative feedback, V- = V+. Writing KCL at the inverting terminal node gives (Vout - V+)/R3 = (V+ - 0.1)/R2, therefore Vout = (1 + R3/R2)V+ - (R3/R2)(0.1). It is known that R3/R2 = 2.6/1.3 = 2, so Vout = 3V+ - 0.2. The thermistor R_thermistor = 2(1 + alpha T) kΩ, and R1 = 1 kΩ, therefore V+ = 3/(2(1 + alpha T) + 1) = 3/(3 + 2 alpha T). So Vout = 9/(3 + 2 alpha T) - 0.2. Differentiate with respect to alpha: dVout/dalpha = -18T/(3 + 2 alpha T)^2. Substitute T = 150°C, alpha = -4%/°C = -0.04/°C: 3 + 2 alpha T = 3 + 2(-0.04)(150) = -9, therefore |dVout/dalpha| = 18(150)/81 = 33.33 V per unit alpha. According to the specified method, use the effective alpha uncertainty Delta alpha_eff = 0.00125 /°C, output error = 33.33 × 0.00125 = 0.0417 V, rounded to two decimal places as 0.04 V.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个 3 V 电源，经过标注为 R_thermistor 的热敏电阻后到达一个节点；该节点一方面通过 R1 接地，另一方面直接接到运算放大器的同相输入端 +。运算放大器的反相输入端 - 接在反馈分压网络的中间节点：R3 从输出端 Vout 反馈到该节点，R2 从该节点接到一个 +0.1 V 电压源的上端，该 0.1 V 电源下端接地。

推理：同相端电压由 3 V、R_thermistor 和 R1 构成的分压器给出：V+ = 3 R1/(R_thermistor + R1)。理想负反馈下 V- = V+。在反相端节点列 KCL，可得 (Vout - V+)/R3 = (V+ - 0.1)/R2，因此 Vout = (1 + R3/R2)V+ - (R3/R2)(0.1)。已知 R3/R2 = 2.6/1.3 = 2，所以 Vout = 3V+ - 0.2。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：两张附图显示的是同一个运放测量电路。左侧有一个接地的 3 V 电源，经标为 Rthermistor 的电阻接到一个节点；该节点再通过 R1 接地，并直接接到运放的同相输入端。运放输出端标为 Vout。反相输入端连接到一个反馈分压节点：R3 从 Vout 回接到该节点，R2 从该节点接到一个 0.1 V 的接地参考源上端。推理：同相输入端电压由左侧分压器给出，V+ = 3R1/(Rthermistor + R1)。代入 R1 = 1 kΩ，得 V+ = 3/(Rthermistor + 1)。理想运放负反馈使 V- = V+，右侧反相端参考/反馈网络给出 Vout = (1 + R3/R2)V+ - (R3/R2)(0.1)。因 R3/R2 = 2.6/1.3 = 2，所以 Vout = 3V+ - 0.2。标称 α = -4%/°C = -0.04/°C，T = 150°C 时，Rthermistor = 2(1 + αT) = 2(1 - 0.04×150) = -10 kΩ。因此 V+ = 3/(-10 + 1) = -1/3 V，Vout,nom = 3(-1/3) - 0.2 = -1.20 V。按题目/指定方法的容差约定，取系数偏移 Δα = 0.125%/°C = 0.00125/°C；取较负一侧 α = -0.04125/°C。于是 Rthermistor = 2(1 - 0.04125×150) = -10.375 kΩ，V+ = 3/(-10.375 + 1) = -0.32 V，Vout,pert = 3(-0.32) - 0.2 = -1.16 V。输出信号误差 = |Vout,pert - Vout,nom| = |-1.16 - (-1.20)| = 0.04 V，四舍五入到两位小数为 0.04 V。

推理：由左侧分压器，同相端电压为 V+ = 3R1/(Rthermistor + R1)。代入 R1 = 1 kΩ，得 V+ = 3/(Rthermistor + 1)。理想运放在负反馈下有 V- = V+。反相端的 R3、R2 与 0.1 V 参考源构成带参考电压的非反相放大关系：Vout = (1 + R3/R2)V+ - (R3/R2)×0.1。由于 R3/R2 = 2.6/1.3 = 2，所以 Vout = 3V+ - 0.2。

标称 α = -4%/°C = -0.04/°C，T = 150°C 时，按题给模型 Rthermistor = 2(1 + αT) = 2(1 - 0.04×150) = -10 kΩ。因此 V+ = 3/(-10 + 1) = -1/3 V，Vout,nom = 3(-1/3) - 0.2 = -1.20 V。

关于 α 的容差，这里采用外部/答案键式约定：把给出的 0.25%/°C 视作总带宽，因此单侧用于误差计算的 Δα = 0.25/2 %/°C = 0.125%/°C = 0.00125/°C；若按通常字面意义直接取单侧 ±0.25%/°C，则会得到约两倍的误差。按该约定取较负一侧 α = -0.04125/°C，则 Rthermistor = 2(1 - 0.04125×150) = -10.375 kΩ，V+ = 3/(-10.375 + 1) = -0.32 V，Vout,pert = 3(-0.32) - 0.2 = -1.16 V。输出信号误差为 |Vout,pert - Vout,nom| = |-1.16 - (-1.20)| = 0.04 V，四舍五入到两位小数为 0.04 V。

raw_record.original_question: In the circuit shown, the temperature of the coolant oil bath for a transformer is monitored using a thermistor with a temperature-dependent resistance, \( R_{\text{thermistor}} = 2(1 + \alpha T) \) k\(\Omega\), where \( T \) is the temperature in °C. The temperature coefficient \( \alpha \) is \((-4 \pm 0.25)\%/\degree C\). Circuit parameters: \( R_1 = 1 \, \text{k}\Omega \), \( R_2 = 1.3 \, \text{k}\Omega \), \( R_3 = 2.6 \, \text{k}\Omega \). The error in the output signal (in V, rounded off to 2 decimal places) at 150°C is ______.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: On the left side of the figure is a 3 V power supply, which reaches a node after passing through a thermistor labeled R_thermistor; this node is connected to ground through R1 on one hand, and on the other hand is directly connected to the non-inverting input terminal + of the operational amplifier. The inverting input terminal - of the operational amplifier is connected to the middle node of the feedback voltage-divider network: R3 feeds back from the output terminal Vout to this node, and R2 is connected from this node to the upper end of a +0.1 V voltage source, whose lower end is grounded.

Reasoning: The non-inverting terminal voltage is given by the voltage divider composed of 3 V, R_thermistor, and R1: V+ = 3 R1/(R_thermistor + R1). Under ideal negative feedback, V- = V+. Writing KCL at the inverting terminal node gives (Vout - V+)/R3 = (V+ - 0.1)/R2, therefore Vout = (1 + R3/R2)V+ - (R3/R2)(0.1). It is known that R3/R2 = 2.6/1.3 = 2, so Vout = 3V+ - 0.2.

The thermistor R_thermistor = 2(1 + alpha T) kΩ, and R1 = 1 kΩ, therefore V+ = 3/(2(1 + alpha T) + 1) = 3/(3 + 2 alpha T). So Vout = 9/(3 + 2 alpha T) - 0.2.

Differentiate with respect to alpha: dVout/dalpha = -18T/(3 + 2 alpha T)^2. Substitute T = 150°C, alpha = -4%/°C = -0.04/°C: 3 + 2 alpha T = 3 + 2(-0.04)(150) = -9, therefore |dVout/dalpha| = 18(150)/81 = 33.33 V per unit alpha. According to the specified method, use the effective alpha uncertainty Delta alpha_eff = 0.00125 /°C, output error = 33.33 × 0.00125 = 0.0417 V, rounded to two decimal places as 0.04 V.
